title: Barfi!
description: A heartwarming story about a deaf and mute young man, Barfi, and his unique love stories.

title: Dangal
description: Former wrestler Mahavir Singh Phogat trains his two daughters to become world-class wrestlers.

title: RRR
description: A fictitious story about two legendary revolutionaries and their journey away from home before they started fighting for their country in the 1920s.

title: Tampopo
description: A truck driver helps a female ramen shop owner learn how to make the perfect ramen.

title: Spirited Away
description: During her family's move to the suburbs, a sullen 10-year-old girl wanders into a world ruled by gods, witches, and spirits, and where humans are changed into beasts.

title: Train to Busan
description: While a zombie apocalypse breaks out in South Korea, a father and daughter struggle to survive on a train from Seoul to Busan.

title: Akira
description: A secret military project endangers Neo-Tokyo when it turns a biker gang member into a rampaging psychic psychopath who can only be stopped by two teenagers and a group of psychics.

title: Princess Mononoke
description: On a journey to find the cure for a Tatarigami's curse, Ashitaka finds himself in the middle of a war between the forest gods and Tatara, a mining colony.

title: Your Name.
description: Two teenagers living in different parts of Japan discover they can swap bodies. They begin to communicate and try to find each other.
